searched.title: Bambu Support for ABS Safety Data Sheet SDS20250723S06
searched.note: All 18 pages read (p.1 is a scanned cover without a text layer, viewed as an image; p.4 viewed as an image to confirm the composition table). Section 3 gives the composition (high impact polystyrene 95-99 %, additive 1-5 %); section 9 says "No data available" for melting point, density and the other physical data; section 2 "Not classified"; section 14 "Not hazardous goods" (IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID, ICAO-TI/IATA).

documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: Support for ABS
Bambu Support for ABS Safety Data Sheet SDS20250723S06

notes: No hex: the store page links no hex-code document for this filament and none is cached, so its only colour value "White (66100)" has no published hex.
No in_the_box: the store page has no What's in the Box list and no official document lists the box contents.

not_published: the TDS states "N/A" for glass transition, Vicat softening (printed "Vicar Softening Temperature", ISO 306), heat deflection (ISO 75, 1.8 and 0.45 MPa) and every mechanical row (Young's modulus, tensile strength, breaking elongation, bending modulus, bending strength, impact strength; X-Y and Z); the SDS section 9 says "No data available". Filament length and hardness are stated nowhere.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: melt index 11.6 ± 0.7 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature N/A, saturated water absorption rate 0.14% (25 °C, 55% RH), spool material PC + ABS (temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size 200 × 67 mm, printing and storage humidity < 20% RH (sealed, with desiccant), nozzle size 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm (kept as a relation), bed surface preparation glue, retraction length 0.6 - 1.0 mm, retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s, chamber temperature 25 - 45 °C (thermal.chamber_temp is the printer chamber key), max overhang angle 55°, max bridging length 30 mm, support "Turn On", odor (odorless), skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility (insoluble in water), resistance to acid, alkali, organic solvent, oil and grease, flammability (flammable), combustion products and their odor.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: model "S06-xx", CLP "Not classified", no hazard pictogram, "Not hazardous goods" for IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID and ICAO-TI/IATA transport, SVHC "Not listed". To review: the section 3 table prints a CLP column ("Flam. Liq. 3, Skin Irrit. 2, Eye Irrit. 2, Acute Tox.4") against the HIPS component while section 2 says the mixture is "Not classified"; section 5 gives combustion products "No data available" while the TDS names water, carbon oxides and nitrogen oxides.

Drying requirement differs between official sources (not a stored key): the store page says "Optional to Dry before Use" (Cautions for Use) and "Dry before use to ensure the best print quality" (Printing Tips › 2.Drying Recommendations); the drying wiki gives "Not required but recommended"; the Support for ABS guide and the support wiki 3.1 say it "usually" / "in most cases" needs no pre-drying, while the support wiki 2.1 lists Support for ABS among filaments with "strict drying requirements". The numeric drying values agree everywhere.

Safety text (no registry key): the Support for ABS guide, the support wiki and the store Printing Tips say that at printing temperatures it may release harmful gases such as styrene, recommend an enclosed printer, ventilation and a vapour-filter mask for long prints, and say it is not food-contact grade. It dissolves in d-limonene (flash point about 48 °C per the support wiki 4.1.3).

Marketing prose is not used for numbers: "0 Top Z distance and 0 Top interface spacing" (feature block 2) is not stored. Variable layer height is "not recommended" (Support for ABS guide; support wiki 3.1): not a registry key.

Not cached, so not read: the store page's "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/9479a16b0736487386ab500723e6c6cb.pdf; safety.certifications is left to review) and the wiki page https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/software/bambu-studio/support (slicer support settings) linked from the Printing Tips.

The material-table wiki was searched but has no Support for ABS row, so it is listed under searched and left out of documents. The Support for ABS guide (wiki) is not linked by the store page; it is added as a document from the curated read.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.05 mm) comes from the store page only (Product Features › bullet 4) and is written by the page layer (verified, official_page); it is not repeated here.
